title: PublicWithinPolicyChanged
description:
`public_within_policy_changed` — the instance switch (`public_within_enabled`) or a team's forbid
(`public_within_forbidden`) changed (spec P4). The only record of the instance switch: settings
updates are otherwise not ledgered. A team-scope record carries the team as its `subject`
reference; an instance-scope record carries none, and is read by system admins.

from.description: The value before: the switch's `enabled`, or the team's `forbidden`.

team_id.description: The team whose forbid changed; absent for the instance switch.

PublicWithinPolicyScope.description: Which policy a [`PublicWithinPolicyChanged`] record is about.

oneOf.description: `kb_teams.public_within_forbidden`, set by the team's owner or an admin.
